source='''def transform(grid):
    """Extend shorter repeated horizontal foreground rows to the longest matching row."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row:
            counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    rows = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        cells = {c for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != bg}
        if cells:
            rows.append((r, cells, min(cells), max(cells)))
    for r, cells, left, right in rows:
        # A row is a shorter copy when another row contains it and has a
        # longer right edge, with nearly the same left alignment.
        candidates = [other for other in rows
                      if abs(other[2] - left) <= 1
                      and cells < other[1]
                      and other[3] > right
                      and all(c > right for c in other[1] - cells)]
        if candidates:
            end = max(item[3] for item in candidates)
            for c in range(right + 1, end + 1):
                if out[r][c] == bg:
                    out[r][c] = 1
    return out
'''
